newsitem.title: CANADA: IPL, NGC form retail natgas venture.
newsitem.headline: IPL, NGC form retail natgas venture.

text.p: Calgary-based IPL Energy Inc and NGC Corp of Houston said on Thursday they formed a joint venture to market retail energy products and services to industrial, commercial and residential customers in Canada.
The venture, called Consumersfirst, is the latest in a growing field of companies selling natural gas on a retail basis in the province of Ontario, Canada's biggest.

IPL chief executive Brian MacNeill told reporters before his company's annual meeting that the joint venture, which combines IPL with NGC unit NGC Canada, is one part of a growing focus on non-regulated energy businesses expected to provide most of the company's growth in the coming years.
IPL's regulated subsidiaries, by far the largest part of the company, include oil pipeline unit Interprovincial Pipe Line Inc and Consumers Gas, Ontario's biggest natural gas utility.
